parsed_json.up: Select compound ChEMBL identifier, canonical SMILES, activity standard type, standard value, and standard units for activities against monoamine oxidase B (CHEMBL221). Join molecule_dictionary to activities, assays, and target_dictionary filtering on target ChEMBL ID CHEMBL221. Join compound_structures as an INNER JOIN to require structures. Return all qualifying activity rows without deduplication. Sort results by potency ascending (standard_value), then by compound ChEMBL identifier, canonical SMILES, standard type, standard value, and standard units. Limit to the first 500 rows.
